Diminish

/dih-MIN-ish/ · verb

Hear It

What It Means

Diminish means to make or become smaller, weaker, or less important.

The company redesigned its packaging to diminish shipping costs, trimming a few cents from every box.

Worked Example

The concert hall installed padded wall panels to diminish the echo that had muddied every performance.

Here 'to diminish' means to reduce: the panels make the echo smaller and weaker. The base form follows 'to,' the way you'll most often meet this word — to diminish a risk, a cost, an effect.

How Diminish Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

reduce

reduce: make smaller in amount

lessen

lessen: make less

weaken

weaken: make less strong

Antonyms

increase

increase: make greater

amplify

amplify: make larger or stronger

How Strong Is It? — trim → diminish → decimate

trim vs. diminish

trim vs. diminish: "Trim" is milder than diminish — you trim a budget by shaving off a little at the edges, while diminishing it makes a real, noticeable cut.

decimate vs. diminish

decimate vs. diminish: "Decimate" is far stronger than diminish — a storm that diminishes a harvest leaves most of it standing; one that decimates it destroys a huge share.

Build the Word

The pieces

Prefix — di-

Prefix — di-: from Latin de-, 'down, away'

Root — min

Root — min: from Latin minuere / minus, 'to lessen; small, less'

Suffix — -ish

Suffix — -ish: verb-forming suffix (from Old French -iss-)

Put it together

Put it together: Down (di-) + lessen (min) + verb ending (-ish): to diminish is literally to 'lessen downward' — to push something toward smaller, weaker, less.

Use the root in a new word: minimum

Use the root in a new word: minimum: The recipe needs a minimum of two eggs — the least amount that will still work.

Root Check

Word Choice

Neutral / slightly formal

Diminish is the base form: use it after 'to,' 'can,' 'will,' or 'could' — to diminish the risk, nothing can diminish her achievement. It works both ways: things can diminish on their own, or something can diminish them. This unit also teaches the ongoing form diminishing and the completed form diminished.
